mappings.note: Split 'chaukdi' into upsarg and mool shabd. Cited at competency level because this 20-outcome frame has no morphology outcome - C-HIN4.2 is the language-system competency, and its LO-200 covers USING words appropriately in writing, not analysing their formation. NB the key is questionable: 'chau' here is a numeral element, not a prefix.
Split 'pratap' into pra + tap - the only sound member of this set. Competency-level C-HIN4.2, as the frame has no morphology outcome.
Split 'savar' into upsarg and mool shabd. Competency-level C-HIN4.2. NB the key ('sa' + 'var') is not a real Hindi prefix analysis.
Split 'badal' into upsarg and mool shabd. Competency-level C-HIN4.2. NB the key ('ba' + 'dal') is wrong - 'badal' is a single morpheme.
Vilom of 'tanik'. LO-190 covers curiosity about words and their meanings; rejected LO-187, which is about a point of the poem.

Asks what Chetak's motion is compared to - the 'badhte nad-sa' simile, LO-195. NB this and the earlier 'chaal ki tulna' item have near-identical stems but different keys (river here, wind there); both similes do occur in the poem, so neither key is wrong, but the pair reads as a duplicate.
